notes: Events with detail_status "full" were opened on Partiful and carry description, capacity, RSVP action, and exact end time (120 of LA's 121 featured/track priority events).
Events with detail_status "none" have calendar metadata only (name, host, day, start time, neighborhood, tracks). Open techweek_url to see the full invite.
One priority event has detail_status "deleted": its techweek_url redirects to a Partiful page that returns "Not Found".
registration_status comes from tech-week.com and can change daily; treat it as a hint, not truth.
